extras.note: wrecks, crates (other than supply piles), docks, scaffolds, projectiles do not exist as shapes. Scaffolds = building shapes lowered by WorldBatch rise (y += lift*(1-rise)). Other non-shape things drawn by WorldBatch: ground shadow diamond, horde ring (24 triangles, RING_RADIUS 11x5.5), muzzle/hit/fade quads, dash streak (see WorldBatch consts).

draw_order.text: Per part, in Shapes.parts order, prims are sorted back to front: key [cx + cy, offset.z, index] with (cx, cy) = offset.xy rotated by the part angle (ShapeBake._back_to_front). Part angle: fixed = 0; heading = bucket*TAU/64; turret = turret bucket*TAU/64, where bucket = posmod(roundi(angle/TAU*64), 64) (roundi rounds half away from zero). Turret parts rotate their pivot (cells, hull frame) by the HULL bucket; their prims are relative to that pivot. Prim ring: box = corners (-hx,-hy),(hx,-hy),(hx,hy),(-hx,hy); cylinder = n points at TAU*(i+0.5)/n of radius size.x/2 with n = 4/6/8 for detail 0/1/2. Each ring point = pivot_rot + (offset.xy + corner) rotated by the part angle (all in cell space). Faces per prim: first the top face as a fan (ring[0], ring[i], ring[i+1]) at lift top = (offset.z + size.z) * 3.5, slot = prim slot; then for each ring edge a->b with normal n = (b-a).rotated(-PI/2): skip when n.x + n.y <= 1e-3*|n| (back-facing); otherwise two side triangles (a,b,b) lifts (top,top,base) and (a,b,a) lifts (top,base,base), base = offset.z*3.5. Side slot: when the prim slot is roof, roof_dark or machine, the side slot is side if n.x - n.y < 0 else side_dark; any other prim slot keeps its own slot on the sides. Vertex screen position = world_to_plane(cell) with y -= lift (px). No per-face darkening beyond slots; roof_dark = owner.darkened(0.25). Parts are concatenated in order, no global sort across prims of different parts. Items are drawn sorted by (layer, floor((ax+ay)*1024), id); air items are shifted up by air_lift px; construction rise<1 adds lift*(1-rise) to every vertex y. Detail = GraphicsSettings.detail(quality, zoom): low quality 0; high: zoom<1 -> 0, <2 -> 1, else 2. Heading is quantised to 64 buckets, so a shape never rotates continuously. Fill only, no outline, no antialiasing.

constants.top_face: triangle fan from ring[0], slot = prim slot
